stage_2_story.text_en:
Last Tuesday, Moshe's grandson Noam surprised him with a special invitation. 'Grandpa,' he said, 'come to the gym with me. I will show you everything.' Moshe was nervous — he had not done real exercise in many years. But he did not want to disappoint Noam, so he agreed.

When they arrived at the gym, Noam started with a warm-up. He jogged slowly on the treadmill for five minutes. 'You must always warm up first, Grandpa,' Noam explained. 'It protects your muscles from injury.' Then Noam showed Moshe some simple stretching exercises for the legs and back.

Next, Noam led Moshe to the weights area. He handed his grandfather a very light weight. 'We will do three sets,' Noam said. 'Each set has ten reps. Lift, lower — that is one rep.' Moshe tried his best. After each set, they took a short rest before continuing.

Moshe felt tired quickly, but Noam was patient and encouraging. 'This is all part of the routine,' Noam said. 'If you come regularly, your fitness will improve every week.'

At the end of the session, Noam showed Moshe how to do a proper cool-down — slow walking and gentle stretching to let the body recover. Driving home, Moshe said: 'I was scared before, but now I feel wonderful. Same time next week?'
